hints.title: Support Difference State Definition
hints.text: Model the problem by tracking the difference between the taller support and the shorter support.

hints.title: Transitioning by Rod Choice
hints.text: For each rod of length x, there are three choices: do not use it, add it to the taller support, or add it to the shorter support.

hints.title: Dynamic Programming Difference Mapping
hints.text: Let dp[diff] store the maximum height of the shorter support. For each rod x, copy dp into next_dp. For each diff: update diff + x with shorter height, and update abs(diff - x) with min(shorter + diff, shorter + x). Finally return dp[0].

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: S: sum of all rod lengths (up to 5000)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Partitioning rods into three subsets (left, right, unused) takes O(3^N) = 3^20 > 3.4 billion operations, causing TLE.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since diff cannot exceed sum(rods) <= 5000, storing max shorter height per diff takes O(S) memory and O(N * S) operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should define the DP state around the difference in height rather than two separate heights.
complexity.notes: dp[0] gives the height of the two equal supports when diff is 0.
